# Peaknizer Logistics

> Peaknizer Logistics is a third-party logistics (3PL) company with its head office in Arlington, Virginia, and warehouses in Houston, Texas and New Jersey. It provides product prep, warehousing, order fulfillment and dropshipping fulfillment for new, small and medium brands across the USA that sell on Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, eBay and TikTok Shop.

Contact: info@peaknizerlogistics.com | +1 (571) 307-4461

Key facts:
- No minimum volume.
- Amazon FBA prep from $0.60 per unit; FBM order fulfillment from $3.00 per order.
- Inventory is checked in the day it arrives; orders received by 2 PM ship the same day.
- Every customer gets an online portal for inventory, shipments and invoices.

## Guides

- [What Is a 3PL? A Simple Guide for Small Ecommerce Brands](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/what-is-a-3pl): What a 3PL (third-party logistics provider) does, what it costs, and the signs that your small ecommerce brand is ready to outsource fulfillment.
- [How to Choose a 3PL Warehouse for a Small Ecommerce Brand](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/how-to-choose-a-3pl-warehouse): The questions to ask before you choose a 3PL warehouse: pricing, minimums, marketplaces, receiving speed, cutoff times, tracking and contracts.
- [Amazon FBA Prep: What It Is and When to Outsource It](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/amazon-fba-prep-guide): What Amazon FBA prep involves, why Amazon stopped offering US prep and labeling services in 2026, and when it makes sense to outsource prep to a 3PL.
- [FBA vs FBM: Which Amazon Fulfillment Method Fits Your Business?](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/fba-vs-fbm): FBA vs FBM explained for small Amazon sellers: how each works, the costs and trade-offs, and how a 3PL can support either method or both.
- [Walmart WFS Prep: How to Get Your Inventory Accepted the First Time](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/walmart-wfs-prep-guide): A practical guide to Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS) prep: barcodes, poly-bags, sets, fragile items and how a 3PL helps avoid prep fees.
- [TikTok Shop Fulfillment: How to Ship Fast When a Video Goes Viral](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/tiktok-shop-fulfillment): How TikTok Shop sellers can keep up with sudden order spikes: shipping speed, late dispatch rate, inventory planning and when to use a 3PL.
- [Multichannel Fulfillment for Walmart, Shopify, eBay and TikTok Shop Sellers](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/multichannel-fulfillment): How to fulfill orders from Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, eBay and TikTok Shop from one stock pool, avoid overselling and keep shipping times consistent.
- [Kitting and Bundling: How Multi-Packs Can Raise Your Average Order Value](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/kitting-and-bundling): What kitting and bundling are, how multi-packs and variety packs can raise order value, and what to know before you outsource bundling to a 3PL.
- [Same-Day Shipping and Order Cutoff Times Explained](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/same-day-shipping-cutoff-times): What an order cutoff time is, how same-day shipping really works at a 3PL, and how cutoff times affect delivery promises and marketplace metrics.
- [Dropshipping From a US Warehouse: How It Works With a 3PL](https://peaknizerlogistics.com/blog/dropshipping-from-a-us-warehouse): How dropshipping fulfillment works with a US 3PL warehouse: sending inventory, uploading orders and labels, and the benefits over shipping from overseas.
